I have farmed this land since I was a young girl, and I know what my soil needs. I will spread cow manure on this rice plot because my family keeps cattle and we have plenty of it, and I will also buy one small bag of urea from the village shop to help the crop grow strong. I will plant the same rice seeds I saved from last season because they have never failed me, and I do not have money for chemicals to spray pests. My children and grandchildren will work this plot with me, but my legs are too weak now for the heavy digging, so I will pay some young men from the village to help with land preparation and harvesting.
